crossRefs.note: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is…
nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of…
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak…
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…
For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. “But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.”
For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ…

translations.web: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
translations.bsb: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
